detail.title: Synthesis of Self-Model Dynamics in Predictive Processing
detail.summary: Continued research into the cognitive basis of identity, specifically examining how predictive processing frameworks explain the maintenance of a consistent self-model. The current work evaluates whether identity is better characterized as a continuous, active recalibration process rather than a static information store. Efforts remain focused on the identity domain, respecting attention constraints while refining the evidentiary basis for current self-model beliefs.
